findings.summary: In the acknowledgement path the shadow build runs inside the final-response guard, so a shadow-side failure is booked as budget.exhausted and suppresses the real acknowledgement turn.
repair_metrics counts every non-PASS validation.completed, including dispatch STALE and later plan steps; tighten before 3f.2.
The replay consumer is honest but sees zero drops under the default policy; it guards a regression, not budget pressure.
Payload keys satisfy PR-26, but context.failed marks the acknowledgement turn as turn:"acknowledgement" while the shadow events use turn:int plus acknowledgement:bool; reconcile in ADR 0032.
